HAM10000_PRIMARY.title: The HAM10000 dataset, a large collection of multi-source dermatoscopic images of common pigmented skin lesions
HAM10000_PRIMARY.use: Defines benign keratosis as a generic class containing seborrheic keratosis, solar lentigo, and lichen-planus-like keratosis.

HIBA_PRIMARY.title: A dataset of skin lesion images collected in Argentina for the evaluation of AI tools in this population
HIBA_PRIMARY.use: Documents the HIBA diagnoses, including solar lentigo, seborrheic keratosis, and lichen planus-like keratosis as distinct source labels.

PAD_PRIMARY.title: PAD-UFES-20: A skin lesion dataset composed of patient data and clinical images collected from smartphones
PAD_PRIMARY.use: Documents the six PAD-UFES-20 diagnostic classes and their abbreviations, including BCC, SCC, ACK, SEK, MEL, and NEV.

ISIC_DX.title: International Skin Imaging Collaboration-Designated Diagnoses (ISIC-DX): Consensus terminology for lesion diagnostic labeling
ISIC_DX.use: Provides the consensus rationale for unique terms and hierarchical mappings in the ISIC diagnostic taxonomy.

ISIC_ARCHIVE.title: International Skin Imaging Collaboration Archive
ISIC_ARCHIVE.use: Authoritative description of the public archive and its image metadata.
